notes.title: BIG UPDATE FOR JEFF-16 !
notes.content:
jEFF-16 was updated !

We listened to some feedback from our testers and we improved a few things;

1.[b] BOOST BUTTON ![/b] - Left Shift.
2. The game is now more accessible to people who can't go through or touch all the yellow hoops. There is now a bigger [b]green hoop around the yellow one[/b] that counts as passing the checkpoint.
3. [b]Out of bounds[/b] mechanic - You can no longer wonder around and get lost :)
4. Prettier and more aesthetic [b]menu[/b].
5. Adjusted [b]controls[/b] - The plane rotates little faster.
6. [b]Inverted controls[/b] on CAPS-LOCK.
7. We added a [b]COMBO mechanic[/b] that shows how many times you went through the yellow hoop perfectly.
8. More satisfying [b]animations [/b]for passing hoops.

Hope you like it ! <3

KAP-GAMES.
